speaker: johan_vosloo
headline: POWER NEEDS A CHAIN OF CUSTODY.
deck: Authority becomes credible when each transfer of power has a named institution, a defined limit and a visible record.
quote: Power should never jump from mandate to outcome without passing through accountable hands.
facts: A mandate should identify the legal source of authority.
Responsibility must remain attached to named institutions.
Enforcement needs explicit limits and review.
Disclosure creates the public record that closes the chain.
takeaway: A legitimate state does not merely possess power; it preserves an auditable chain of responsibility.
